items.headline: Indian Equities Open Higher Amidst Mixed Global Cues; US Fed Decision Anticipated
items.summary: Indian Sensex and Nifty opened in the green on September 16, 2026, recovering slightly after significant drops in the previous session. Market sentiment is cautious due to anticipation of a 25 basis point US Fed rate hike, rising crude oil prices (Brent above $107), higher US Treasury yields, and persistent FII selling. Asian markets show mixed to slightly positive movements.

items.headline: RBI Monitors Inflation Closely; Rate Hike Possible in Q3 FY27
items.summary: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee maintained the repo rate at 5.25% in August 2026, but minutes suggest a potential rate tightening in Q3 FY27 if food and fuel prices continue to drive inflation. Retail inflation rose to a 20-month high of 4.8% in August, making an October rate hike more likely. The Indian rupee opened at 95.89 to the dollar.

items.headline: Government Introduces 0.4% MDR on UPI Merchant Transactions Above ₹2,000
items.summary: Effective October 15, a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) will be applied to UPI merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 for transactions over ₹75,000. This fee, paid by merchants, is expected to create new revenue streams for banks and payment companies in the UPI ecosystem.

items.headline: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd to Announce Financial Results Today
items.summary: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd is scheduled to announce its financial results today, September 16, 2026.

items.headline: FMCG and PSU Banking Shares Lead Early Gains; Mutual Funds Reduce Consumer Exposure
items.summary: In early trade, FMCG and PSU banking shares saw significant gains. Mutual funds have cut their exposure to consumer stocks to a nearly 10-year low in August, while increasing allocations to healthcare, capital goods, e-commerce, insurance, and NBFCs.

items.headline: IT Sector Sees Buying Interest; Realty and Capital Goods Under Selling Pressure
items.summary: The IT sector, including HCL Technologies, Infosys, and TCS, saw buying interest on Tuesday, while realty and capital goods sectors experienced selling pressure.

items.headline: M&A Emerges as Core Growth Strategy for Indian Companies
items.summary: Mergers and acquisitions are increasingly becoming a central growth strategy for Indian companies, with annual deal volumes more than doubling since fiscal 2017.

items.headline: Dividends, Listings, and IPOs Scheduled for September 16, 2026
items.summary: Several companies have corporate actions today: Blue Dart Express, Hi-Tech Gears, KKV Agro Powers, Tilaknagar Industries, Aarti Pharma Labs, Pondy Oxides & Chemical, Yash Optics & Lens, IL&FS Investment Managers, HP Adhesives, Hexagon Nutrition, and Mason Infratech are paying dividends. Kanohar Electricals, Prasol Chemicals, and Glass Wall Systems (India) shares are listing. Hero Motors, SS Retail, and Jindal Supreme India IPOs are opening.

items.headline: Payment and Financial Stocks In Focus Due to UPI MDR Introduction
items.summary: Payment and financial stocks like Paytm, YES Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and SBI are in focus following the government's introduction of a 0.4% MDR on UPI merchant transactions above ₹2,000. Citi believes YES Bank will be a primary beneficiary.

items.headline: Groww Faces Potential Block Deal by Peak XV Partners and Sequoia Capital
items.summary: A block deal is anticipated for Groww, with Peak XV Partners Investments and Sequoia Capital expected to sell up to 10.02 crore equity shares (1.6% stake) for an estimated ₹1,918.3 crore.

items.headline: Saatvik Green Energy Secures ₹1,041.63 Crore Order from SECI
items.summary: Saatvik Green Energy has received a significant order worth ₹1,041.63 crore from the Solar Energy Corporation of India for solar photovoltaic modules.

items.headline: Sonata Software Enters Strategic Collaboration with Amazon Web Services
items.summary: Sonata Software has signed a five-year Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate cloud adoption for its clients.

items.headline: BHEL to Form Joint Venture with Titagarh Rail Systems for Vande Bharat Train Maintenance
items.summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd (BHEL) is set to form a 50:50 joint venture with Titagarh Rail Systems for the comprehensive maintenance of Vande Bharat Sleeper Trainsets for a period of 35 years.

items.headline: R R Kabel Commences Commercial Production at New Silvassa Unit
items.summary: R R Kabel has successfully commenced commercial production at its new wires and cables manufacturing unit (Unit 3) located in Silvassa.

items.headline: Aurobindo Pharma Subsidiary Receives US FDA Procedural Observation
items.summary: Apitoria Pharma, a subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma, received one procedural observation from the US FDA after an inspection of its API manufacturing facility.

items.headline: NBCC India Bags Multiple New Orders Worth ₹144.98 Crore
items.summary: NBCC India has secured multiple new orders, aggregating to approximately ₹144.98 crore, excluding GST.

items.headline: Vikram Solar to Supply 1 GW N-Type TOPCon Solar Cells to Avaada Electro
items.summary: Vikram Solar has signed an agreement with Avaada Electro for the supply of 1 GW of N-Type TOPCon solar cells.

items.headline: GMR Airports Infrastructure Reports Slight Passenger Traffic Increase in August
items.summary: GMR Airports Infrastructure reported 9.4 million passengers across its airports in August 2026, marking a 0.9% year-on-year increase, despite a decline in traffic at Hyderabad Airport.

items.headline: Uno Minda Plans ₹1,415 Crore Investment for Strategic Expansion
items.summary: Uno Minda announced plans to invest Rs 1,415 crore for strategic expansion across its various business verticals.

content.outlook: The Indian market saw a positive close, led by strong performances in FMCG, Realty, and Banking sectors, with NIFTY 50 up by +0.60%. Despite broad market strength and positive breadth, the IT sector was a notable underperformer. Domestic institutional buying provided support amidst foreign institutional selling, suggesting a resilient undertone before the open.
keyTakeaways: NIFTY 50 and SENSEX recorded positive gains of +0.60% and +0.55% respectively.
FMCG (+1.81%) and Realty (+1.34%) were the top performing sectors.
NIFTY BANK also showed strength, closing +0.91% higher.
The IT sector was a significant drag, with NIFTY IT down -1.04% and major IT stocks among top losers.
FIIs were net sellers (-2977.86cr) while DIIs were net buyers (+2686.05cr).
Market breadth remained positive with 42 advancing stocks against 16 declining stocks.
